hypotheses.reasoning: catalog-db hit its limits: connections 485/500 and CPU 96% at 07:41:10, which was the earliest anomaly on the search path. After that, simple PK lookups on products turned slow (3.5s, 7.3s, 5.2s). search-api queries then timed out at 5000ms, and web-bff returned 504s on /search. The notif-worker crash loop (poison message) and the metrics-agent exporter errors look unrelated. I found no deploy and no trigger for the load increase, so the origin is not fully explained.
catalog-db is slow to answer, so search-api calls to it time out. This fits if the DB slowness is the fault itself rather than resource limits.

verdict.recommendedAction: Investigate catalog-db load: find the clients holding connections and the source of the CPU use. Add connection pooling or raise the limit, scale the DB, and cap search-api concurrency. Treat the notif-worker poison message (offset 829709) as a separate issue.
